_comment: GENERATED by tools/build-card-ladder.mjs — graded SOLD marks (PSA 9 / PSA 10 / TAG 10) per card. A row counts only when the sale's own title names the grade; mark = median of >=3 sales in 30d else >=2 in 90d; `last` is one dated sale, never a mark. No titles, sellers or item ids stored. day = the last full read; each card's asOf = its own read.
